'''Kirill Ilyich Zamarayev''' ({{langx|ru|link=no|Кирилл Ильич Замараев; May 20, 1939 – June 26, 1996}}) was a Soviet and Russian physical chemist, specialist in the field of [[catalysis]], [[Astronomical spectroscopy|radiospectroscopy]] and [[chemical kinetics]] in condensed matter.<ref name="multiple">{{cite book| author = Ламин В. А. | chapter = | chapter-url = | format = | url =  | title = Энциклопедия. Новосибирск | orig-year = | agency =  | edition =   |location= Новосибирск |year= 2003 |publisher= Новосибирское книжное издательство |volume=  | pages = 332| series =  | isbn = 5-7620-0968-8}}</ref>

==Biography==
He was born on May 20, 1939, in [[Moscow]].<ref name="multiple" />

In 1963, Zamarayev graduated from the [[Moscow Institute of Physics and Technology]], after which he worked in this educational institution.<ref name="multiple" />

From 1966 to 1977, he worked at the [[Semenov Institute of Chemical Physics|Institute of Chemical Physics]].<ref name="multiple" />

From 1977, Zamarayev served as deputy director of the [[Boreskov Institute of Catalysis|Institute of Catalysis]] in [[Novosibirsk]]. He later became the director (1984–1995) of this organization, and at the same time, the head of the department of [[Novosibirsk State University]].<ref name="multiple" />

Zamarayev was a delegate to the 18th All-Union [[Komsomol|Lenininst Young Communist League.]]<ref name="multiple" />

He was also a member of the Central Council of Young Scientists of the Central Committee of the All-Union Lenininst Young Communist League, president of the department of physical chemistry, president of the [[International Union of Pure and Applied Chemistry]], foreign member of the Indian National Academy of Sciences, chairman of the scientific council of the [[State Committee for Science and Technology]] on problems ''"Catalysis and its industrial uses"'',<ref name="multiple" /> chairman of the Joint Scientific Council of Chemical Sciences (from 1992), Deputy Chairman of the Scientific Council of the Academy of Sciences for Catalysis and member of the [[Siberian Branch of the Russian Academy of Sciences|SB RAS]] Presidium (1988–1996).<ref name="multiple" />

[[file:Cherbuzinskoye cemetery3016.jpg|thumb|left|The grave of Kirill Zamarayev at the Yuzhnoye Cemetery, Novosibirsk.]]

Zamarayev died on June 26, 1996, and was buried at the [[Yuzhnoye Cemetery (Novosibirsk)|Yuzhnoye Cemetery]] (Novosibirsk).<ref name="multiple" />

==Scientific activity==
He was engaged in research in the field of conversation of solar power into chemical energy.<ref name="multiple" />

He discovered and investigated tunnel reactions of electron transfer over long distances.<ref name="multiple" />

==Awards==
* Karpinsky FFS Foundation Prize (1995)<ref name="multiple" />

===Orders===
* [[Order of the Badge of Honour]] (1982)
* [[Order of the Red Banner of Labour]] (1986)
* [[Order of Friendship]] (1996)<ref name="multiple" />

==Memory==
A charitable scientific foundation and an auditorium of Novosibirsk State University are named after him.<ref name="multiple" />

A memorial plaque can be viewed on the building of the Institute of Catalysis.<ref name="multiple" />
